source_row.wylie: [iv.297-300] gnyis pa ni, mdo las, mthong ba dang , thos pa dang , rnam par shes pa dang, rtogs pa bzhi la, ma mthong zhes sogs bzhi dang , ma mthong zhes sogs bzhi la, mthong zhes sogs bzhi ste byis pa'i tha snyad brgyad dang
source_row.english: Now sutra makes mention of the "eight expressions of a child" [one who has yet to see selflessness directly], which consist of: 1) four types where you say "I didn't see it" and so on about four different kinds of things--things that you really did see, hear, know, or sense; and 2) four types where you say "I did see it" and so on about another four kinds of things--things that you really didn't see, hear, know, or sense.

Hearing belongs to the actual positive list, not the later negative list expanded from SOGS.
The technical cognition expression is know in the first positive list. Complete glossary and the local356 explanation distinguish this from sensed.
